caption: The drawing depicts a single dress centered on a plain, light beige background. The dress has a fitted bodice with short sleeves and a wide, gathered skirt extending to mid-calf length. The fabric of the dress is predominantly dark blue and features a repeating pattern of various flowers in multiple colors, including pink, yellow, green, purple, and white. There is a white lace detail that starts at the rounded neckline, extends down the front of the bodice in a vertical line, and spreads partially across the shoulders. The dress appears to have a structured waistline, enhancing the fullness of the skirt. The illustration is rendered with careful attention to the details of the fabric pattern and the lace trim. There are no additional objects or background elements present in the composition.
